balance_sheet_equation.name: Accounting Equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity)
balance_sheet_equation.description: Verifies that total assets equal total liabilities plus stockholders' equity within allowable rounding/presentation tolerances.

operating_income_presentation.name: Operating Income Presentation (Gross Profit - Operating Expenses)
operating_income_presentation.description: Validates operating income against gross profit minus traceable operating expenses where operating expenses are disclosed.

yoy_variance.name: Year-over-Year Variance Analysis
yoy_variance.description: Flags canonical metrics with year-over-year percentage variances exceeding the anomaly threshold for auditor review without asserting fraud.

cross_statement_net_income.name: Net Income Cross-Statement Consistency
cross_statement_net_income.description: Verifies that net income on the income statement matches net income reported on the cash flow statement for the same period.

cross_statement_cash.name: Cash & Cash Equivalents Cross-Statement Consistency
cross_statement_cash.description: Verifies cash and cash equivalents reported on the balance sheet against ending cash on the cash flow statement where comparable.

segment_reconciliation.name: Segment Breakdown Reconciliation
segment_reconciliation.description: Verifies that reported dimensional segment line items reconcile cleanly with consolidated totals.
